stories.title: Keep concurrent configuration
stories.text: My saved view choices do not erase MCP changes or pretend a published write never occurred.

stories.title: Remember the view
stories.text: My current view choices can be remembered for myself or this project and restored after restart, with their active and saved scope clear.

stories.title: Keep startup and input responsive
stories.text: Saving or loading preferences preserves normal startup, appearance and ongoing interaction without launching extra services.
